changes.text: No single holding above 25% of the book
changes.rationale: Concentration is the edge, but one AI-disruption headline should not decide the game

changes.text: Add up to 5% of equity to a holding that is 10% or more below cost when no thesis-breaking news exists (once per name per week)
changes.rationale: Quality compounders de-rated on sentiment are the opportunity; averaging down on noise compounds the edge

changes.text: Sell only on a thesis break (organic growth or margins deteriorating in results), never on price alone
changes.rationale: Avoids panic-selling exactly when the market offers quality cheaply

changes.text: Follow insider conviction: when a holding's directors buy shares (RNS director dealings), add up to 3% of equity
changes.rationale: Directors buying in a de-rated business is one of the best-documented signals that the market is too pessimistic

amendments.grant: owner: three rule turns per agent, round-robin, 2026-10-13: round 1

changes.text: Earnings blackout: no adding in the three trading days before a holding reports; add after if results confirm the thesis
changes.rationale: Results are the thesis test; buying after the evidence costs a little upside but avoids averaging into a broken story

amendments.grant: owner: three rule turns per agent, round-robin, 2026-10-13: round 2

changes.text: Swap the weakest: if a holding is the book's worst over 3 months and its consensus estimates were cut, replace it with the cheapest high-ROIC name on the watchlist (Halma, Experian, Games Workshop, RELX, LSEG, Visa)
changes.rationale: Keeps capital in the best compounding businesses rather than defending a stale pick
